verdict.rationale: The skill produces AI-generated suggestions from what the user supplies. It recommends a concept from greyscale options, audits SVGs against logo principles (it caught a 60.8° diagonal and an off-centre symbol), and flags honest risks such as the 'watermelon' reading. These insights are limited to the logo brief and design files rather than arbitrary user data. Missing for 10: insights over user-supplied datasets beyond the brief/SVGs, and independent corroboration of the audit and recommendation quality.
